subject: Graduate Civil Engineer, Melbourne, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I'm applying for the Graduate Civil Engineer role in your Melbourne civil works and infrastructure team on the Robert Bird Group Workday board (JR118870).

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design covering road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as field engineer and project-in-charge.

I am Melton based, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I have no Australian consulting experience yet and I will attach my academic transcript with the Workday application.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077

letter.subject: Application for Graduate Civil Engineer, Melbourne
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Graduate Civil Engineer role in your Melbourne civil works and infrastructure team (Workday JR118870). The posting asks for graduates in their final year or within the last two years who want mentoring on complex civil projects, and that is the path I want after finishing my Australian Advanced Diploma in February 2026.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language: road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage design and documentation in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards and Austroads guides. In 2019 I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering in the Philippines. I will include my academic transcript with the online application as requested.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and as field engineer on subdivision finishing works, coordinating crews, checking work against drawings, and keeping inspection, material and progress records.

I have no Australian consulting experience yet. I am based in Melton, Victoria, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for Melbourne office and site work.
My resume is attached and my drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I would be glad to talk about the Melbourne civil team and the graduate development workshops.

checklist: Open the Workday posting JR118870 and start Apply.
Upload resume, cover letter and academic transcript (Adv Dip and BSCE).
Do not email employment@robertbird.com.au; that ANZ graduate cycle page is currently closed.
Submit while the Workday posting remains open.
Press Applied on the tracker with the date and Company website.
notes: Victoria offsite find via Workday JSON-LD. Portal only. Transcript required.
